description: Na₃NiBSO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.87 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.81 Å. Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.19 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.36-1.41 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-48°. There are three shorter (1.49 Å) and one longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond length. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry to three Na, one Ni, and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ni, and one B atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ni, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ni, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ni, and one S atom.
